svg.title: P0 / Match playable terrain to the 2D map
svg.desc: Top-down survey sketch inspired by image 1's missing minimap terrain and image 3's route. Six coloured mission areas follow a continuous white-cell route around the far-eastern bypass. A magnified minimap uses the same survey coordinates as its highlighted window.
svg.metadata: Source: Docs/Images/MissionLoopV1/PARIS_GRID_25CM_EXPANDED_L0_20261007.png; SHA256 985c64f17bb594b4821fb221d614e58bcf3d297815f07cf6ff09069bb2e74431. Crop X=5..145m, Y=-225..-18m. Vector annotations are proposed design, not accepted movement or a deletion inventory.

g.text: P0 / Match playable terrain to the 2D map
Six coloured mission areas, a connected survey route and a matching player-centred minimap.
appear on the map around the player.
Extend map coverage as the route grows.
Block access beyond the intended area.
Colour marks the intended encounter streets;
Blue square → matching illustrative HUD window
Outside: retain scenery and restrict access.
Red × marks the excluded old shortcut.
Coloured streets: proposed encounter areas. Black: blocked, unknown or unadmitted. Triangles: proposed enemy positions.
Route is continuous through white survey centres in 2D; native ground, NavMesh and squad passage still require checks.
